newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: RESEARCH ALERT-Bangert cuts Randstad to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Bangert cuts Randstad to hold.

text.p: COMMENT: Hold (vs Buy). ...Three quarters of the temporary employment agencies make agreements with employees based on net wages, whereby part-time workers in particular lose the advantage of the tax-free allowance.

Trade Union Dienstenbond FNV is demanding temping agencies make contracts based on gross wages, as a result of which tax advantages will flow to the workers instead of the agencies. The conflict...is bad news for the sector.

Randstad, as market leader in the Netherlands, will suffer most if agreements based on net wages are prohibited. Solutions to compensate for negative effects will weaken Randstad's competitive position compared to (competitors) Start and Manpower.

Based on the current uncertainty relating to the conflict with the trade union and a further weakening sentiment for the sector, we downgrade our recommendation from Buy to Hold. -- Amsterdam newsroom, +31 20 504 5000 (Fax +31 20 504 5040)
